cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Them Think They Won
cards.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Congratulations on winning the cake contest, Mum.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your cake isn't on the judging table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It stayed in the kitchen where I can admire it privately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still beat seven cakes that had every intention of winning.

mechanism: A corrects the comparison set in Mum's win to hide A's withdrawal and preserve her confidence.
confusable: D196 seeks own deserved credit; D207 protects another by obscuring A's concession.
comparison: Family competition withdrawal differs from deliberately underused chess power.
seedUse: Keep missing cake and explicit suspicion; use real displayed entries as the professional comparison.
